# 060 — Emacs colorscheme format

priority: 40

tags: emitters, packaging

## What & why

Emacs is the largest editor audience Candela doesn't cover, and its theme format is a
direct face-to-token map — no design work, just a `deftheme` per palette. Cheapest
remaining editor with a real user base.

## Spec

New emitter `emitEmacsTheme` in `lib/emitters.js`, one file per theme:
`build/emacs/candela-<id>-theme.el`.

```elisp
;;; candela-<id>-theme.el --- Candela <Name> -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
;; Generated by scripts/generate.js, do not edit.
(deftheme candela-<id> "Candela <Name>.")
(custom-theme-set-faces
 'candela-<id>
 '(default ((t (:background "#…" :foreground "#…"))))
 …)
(provide-theme 'candela-<id>)
```

Face map — follow the same token roles the Neovim emitter uses
(`NVIM_SYNTAX`, `lib/emitters.js:~1000`), translated to Emacs faces:

| Face | Token |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `ink` on `bg` |
| `cursor` | `cursor` |
| `region` | bg `selection` |
| `hl-line` | bg `lineHighlight` |
| `fringe`, `mode-line`, `header-line` | `surface` |
| `vertical-border`, `window-divider` | `border` |
| `line-number` | `ink2` |
| `line-number-current-line` | `ink` |
| `font-lock-comment-face`, `font-lock-doc-face` | `faint` |
| `font-lock-keyword-face` | `kw` |
| `font-lock-string-face` | `str` |
| `font-lock-function-name-face` | `fn` |
| `font-lock-constant-face`, `font-lock-number-face` | `num` |
| `font-lock-type-face` | `type` |
| `font-lock-builtin-face`, `font-lock-variable-name-face` | `builtin` |
| `font-lock-punctuation-face`, `font-lock-operator-face` | `punct` |
| `error`, `diff-removed` | `error` |
| `warning` | `warning` |
| `success`, `diff-added` | `ok` |
| `link` | `fn` |
| `minibuffer-prompt` | `builtin` |
| `isearch`, `lazy-highlight` | bg `selection`, fg `ink` |

Also set `ansi-color-names-vector` from `resolveAnsi(ansiMapping, colors)` so
term/eshell follow the palette, and set the theme's background-mode via
`(setq frame-background-mode '<light|dark>)`-equivalent face attributes derived from
`theme.mode` (mirror how `emitNvimPackage` rewrites `vim.o.background`).

Packaging: drop-in files, so add a `bundles[]` entry in `scripts/package-bundles.js`
(`tool: 'emacs'`, `extension: '.el'`) — that script already asserts one file per theme
and writes `dist/candela-themes-emacs-<version>.tar.gz` with a `README.txt`.

**Implementation boundary**
- Owns: `lib/emitters.js` (emitter + `FORMAT_EMITTERS` entry + `INSTALL_STEPS` entry),
  `scripts/generate.js` (the `FORMAT_EMITTERS.length` assert and a log line),
  `scripts/package-bundles.js` (one `bundles[]` entry),
  `app/src/ExportControls.tsx` (`FORMAT_DESCRIPTIONS` entry),
  `README.md` (an `### Emacs` section under `## Install`).
- Excluded: MELPA submission (needs its own repo + recipe PR); groom separately.
- Excluded: a `candela-themes.el` loader package or autoloads — plain `deftheme` files
  loaded from `custom-theme-load-path` are enough.

## Acceptance criteria

- `npm run build` writes 24 `build/emacs/candela-<id>-theme.el` files.
- Adding `build/emacs/` to `custom-theme-load-path` and running `M-x load-theme` lists every Candela theme and applies one cleanly, with no "unsafe theme" byte-compile warnings.
- Comments, keywords, strings, functions, numbers, types, built-ins and punctuation each take their Candela token in a spot-checked buffer (one light, one dark).
- `npm run package:bundles` writes `dist/candela-themes-emacs-<version>.tar.gz` with 24 `.el` files plus `README.txt`.
- The explorer's `/editor` Export picker offers Emacs and its zip installs cleanly.
- README documents the install under `## Install`.
- Green: `node scripts/validate.js`, `npm run build`, `cd app && npm ci && npm run build`.
